mapper.sql:
FROM knowledge_item k
AND (k.title LIKE #{query.keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!' OR k.content_md LIKE #{query.keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_item_tag kt INNER JOIN tag t ON t.id=kt.tag_id WHERE kt.knowledge_item_id=k.id AND t.name LIKE #{query.keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!'))
AND k.category_id=#{query.categoryId} AND k.category_id IS NULL
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_item_tag kt WHERE kt.knowledge_item_id=k.id AND kt.tag_id=#{query.tagId})
mapper.select: SELECT k.* ORDER BY k.updated_at DESC, k.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
